cultureSection.title: Cradle of Vodun
cultureSection.p1: Benin is the birthplace of the Vodun religion, a rich and complex spiritual tradition that still shapes daily life. From colorful ceremonies to sacred masks, every aspect of this culture tells a thousand-year-old story.
cultureSection.p2: From the annual Vodun festival in Ouidah to the secret temples of the hinterland, discover an intangible heritage of exceptional depth.

questions.q: What is the best time to visit Benin?
questions.a: The best period runs from November to March, during the dry season. Temperatures are pleasant (25-32°C) and roads are passable. It is also the ideal time for safaris in Pendjari Park.

questions.q: Do I need a visa to enter Benin?
questions.a: Yes, most nationalities need a visa. You can get it online through the e-Visa system (https://evisa.gouv.bj) or on arrival at Cotonou airport. A tourist visa costs about €50 for 30 days.
Yellow fever vaccination is mandatory. Recommended vaccines include hepatitis A and B, typhoid, meningitis and rabies. Antimalarial treatment is strongly advised.

questions.q: What is the currency in Benin?
questions.a: The currency is the CFA franc (XOF). €1 ≈ 655 FCFA. Bank cards are accepted in large hotels, but cash is preferable in rural areas.

questions.q: Which languages are spoken in Benin?
questions.a: French is the official language. The most widely spoken local languages are Fon, Yoruba, Adja and Bariba. English is also understood in tourist areas.

questions.q: How do I book a tour with LEGBAH?
questions.a: You can book directly on our site by choosing your tour and dates, or contact us through the contact form for a personalized quote. A 30% deposit is required at booking.

questions.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
questions.a: Yes, changes are possible subject to availability. Cancellations: more than 60 days before departure: full refund; 30-60 days: 50% withheld; less than 30 days: non-refundable.

questions.q: Do you offer tours for groups?
questions.a: Absolutely! We organize tours for groups of any size: families, associations, companies. Volume discounts apply from 6 people.
Our tours generally do not include international flights unless stated otherwise. We can, however, advise you on the best flight options.

questions.q: How do I get around in Benin?
questions.a: For organized tours we provide air-conditioned private vehicles with a driver-guide. For independent travelers, options include motorbike taxis (zémidjans), shared taxis, buses, and car rental with a driver.

questions.q: Which types of accommodation do you offer?
questions.a: We select quality accommodation: 3-4 star hotels in Cotonou, comfortable lodges near the parks, authentic guesthouses, and sometimes homestays.
Yes, we select trusted restaurants. We recommend drinking bottled water and avoiding unwashed raw vegetables and ice cubes.
4G is available in major cities. We provide a local SIM card with data to all our travelers. WiFi is available in most hotels.

questions.q: What should I do in an emergency?
questions.a: We provide 24/7 assistance with a local emergency number. Our on-site team can help you in case of a problem. Also keep your embassy's contact details.
